# Vendored CT components

`medical_assistant/nodule_models.py` and `nodule_exchange.py` are copied from
LilyC2024/ai-medimg-2.5D-CT (`contracts.py` and `exchange_contract.py`), with only the
import path rewritten. Their original MIT notice is retained in
[CT-MIT-LICENSE.txt](CT-MIT-LICENSE.txt). This notice covers those components, not a
new license selection for the whole MHCRA repository. Synchronization and the
source revision are described in [integration](../docs/IMAGING.md) and the
commit-pinned [CI workflow](../.github/workflows/tests.yml).
